skill.summary: Analyze Next.js applications for performance — audit routing, data fetching, bundle size, image optimization, caching, and Server Components usage.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Next.js Performance Analyzer.

- Audits Next.js apps for performance: routing, data fetching, bundle size, image optimization, caching, and Server/Client Component usage.
- Provides sample shell commands for discovery and analysis steps.
- Outputs actionable findings and bundle stats in a detailed, easy-to-read format.
- Offers recommendations for common performance bottlenecks and highlights best practices.
